newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European City Estates in intl venture.
newsitem.headline: European City Estates in intl venture.

text.p: Dutch-based property fund European City Estates NV said on Monday it had set up an investment partnership with Apollo Real Estate Investment Fund of the U.S. and London-based Pelham Partners.
"European City Estates has injected into the partnership 50 percent of its Dutch property portfolio, valued at about 70 million guilders," the Dutch group said.
The property transferred to the partnership consists of two business parks in Amsterdam and the southern Netherlands, and office and retail property in the Hague.
These properties have a net return of more than nine percent and offer good medium term growth potential, European City Estates said.
The group said the partnership would enable it to grow throughout Europe and that the deal would offer Britain's Pelham a strategic entry into the Netherlands.

Since 1993, the Apollo Real Estate Investment Fund has made investments of more than five billion dollars, recently completing a series of joint ventures together with Pelham Partners in the United Kingdom, Spain and Belgium, European City Estates said.
